flowchart TD PROFILE["Heart Rate Sensor Profile (HRP)"]
subgraph SERVICES["Primary GATT Services"] S1["Generic Access Service (0x1800)"] S2["Battery Service (0x180F)"] S3["Heart Rate Service (0x180D)"] S4["Custom Control Service (0xFFF0)"] end
subgraph CHARACTERISTICS["Characteristics (Value + Properties)"] C1["Device Name (0x2A00) [READ] 'PulseGlow BLE'"] C2["Battery Level (0x2A19) [READ, NOTIFY] 92%"] C3["Heart Rate Measurement (0x2A37) [NOTIFY] Flags, BPM, RR"] C4["Body Sensor Location (0x2A38) [READ] 1 (Chest)"] C5["Mode Control (0xFFF1) [READ, WRITE] 0 (Resting)"] end
subgraph DESCRIPTORS["Descriptors (Metadata & Config)"] D1["CCCD (0x2902) Client Characteristic Config"] D2["CCCD (0x2902) Client Characteristic Config"] end
PROFILE --> S1 & S2 & S3 & S4 S1 --> C1 S2 --> C2 S3 --> C3 & C4 S4 --> C5 C2 --> D1 C3 --> D2
